title: Clip editor

verdict.reject: Not ready to publish on its own
verdict.retentionHint: How sure it is this works: checks the hook, captions, face, safe zones, silences and audio
verdict.backwardHint: The phrase triggered backward: the clip starts before the moment you said it
verdict.forwardHint: The phrase triggered forward: the clip continues after the moment you said it
verdict.trimmedBody: Original bounds: {inicio} s → {fin} s. Tap Undo to bring them back.
verdict.trimReverted: Done, we restored the original bounds.
verdict.trimNoop: This clip was never trimmed, there's nothing to undo.
verdict.trimError: We couldn't undo it. Try again in a moment.
verdict.autofixReady: It's ready to publish on its own.

rejectedNote: You discarded this clip. You can approve it again whenever you want.
approvedNote: Approved. You can keep adjusting it and approve it again.
publishedNote: This clip was already published. You can download it; it can't be edited anymore.
queueDone: You reviewed every clip from this job.
actionError: We couldn't do that. Try again.

modal.title: This clip isn't 100% yet
modal.body: The AI already fixed what it could and rated it {n}% ready to publish. You can approve it as is or keep editing.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.sub: this is how the final clip will look

fitHint.blurred_bg: Full horizontal frame on a blurred background
fitHint.letterbox: Full horizontal frame with black bars

modeHint.raw: The cut as is, no overlays

preview.note: This is only the preview. When you download or publish, the title, banner and captions are burned into a new video: that's the one that gets uploaded.
preview.timelineEmpty: We didn't find highlights: this clip has no transcript, chat or visual signals to review.
preview.seekHint: Tap to jump to that moment
preview.captionsNoTranscript: no transcript yet: process this stream
preview.captionsEmpty: no voice detected in this stream: check the audio or process it again
preview.captionsOld: the transcript is old (no per-word timing): process the stream again

target.title: Where will you post it?
target.sub: pick one and everything else adjusts to what works there

blurb.tiktok: Full subject · blurred backdrop · captions lower-middle
blurb.reels: Full subject · starfield backdrop · captions lower-middle
blurb.shorts: Full subject · lower-middle captions · clean KICK banner
blurb.kick: Native streamer banner · LIVE pill · letterbox-safe
blurb.all: Safest cross-platform export: full subject on every feed

style.title: Clip style
style.sub: fine-tune how the banner, hook and captions look

desc.repost_page_viral: Kick-style black banner with a big logo and URL, white headline up top and word-by-word captions. The repost-page look.
desc.clean_creator: Just the URL at the bottom, subtle captions and no top headline. Your face is the moment.
desc.gaming_chaos: Heavy emphasis, max animation, big captions and a green Kick block. For raids, jumpscares and big plays.
desc.documentary: Story style. Small bottom banner, no top headline and typewriter captions.
desc.minimal_native: No banner, no headline. Captions only, so it looks recorded on a phone.

hook.title: Viral hook
hook.sub: the first thing people read: it decides if they stay or scroll
hook.label: Hook title
hook.placeholder: e.g. He asked for a rematch after losing again
hook.hint: Leave it empty for no title. The ones that work best have 6 to 10 words with curiosity, conflict or status.
hook.use: Tap to use it as the hook title
hook.none: No hook came out: try another tone.
hook.error: We couldn't generate them. Try again.
hook.fallback: The AI didn't answer: we built these from what you said in the clip.

captions.title: Captions
captions.burn: Burn the captions into the clip

presets.karaoke_pop: Karaoke: highlights word by word with a bounce
presets.bold_block: Bold block: 2 to 3 words, hard cut
presets.subtle: Subtle: one line at the bottom, no animation

positions.lower_third: Under the face: below your face (recommended)
positions.upper_third: Viral top: over the face, poster look
positions.centered: Follow the face: at eye level
positions.bottom: Safe bottom: just above the app's buttons

captions.positionHint: Most people leave it on Viral auto. The AI picks per app.

brand.title: Your brand
brand.sub: your URL on the banner, just like on your stream
brand.banner: Show a KICK-style banner at the bottom
brand.context: Show app context (LIVE badge and chat)
brand.simHint: It's only a simulation, never burned in. Pick the app where you'll post.

variants.kick_repost_page: Repost: black bar, huge KICK and URL (default)
variants.kick_black_bar_classic: Classic: color strip, app on the left and URL on the right
variants.kick_minimal_url: Minimal: just the URL, no box

brand.liveBadge: Show the LIVE pill (repost banner only)

export.title: Download
export.qualityLocked: 2K and 4K come with the VIP plan. On your plan it downloads in 1080p.
export.savedFirst: We saved your changes before preparing the video.

analysis.why: Why the AI picked this clip
analysis.noTranscript: This clip has no transcript yet, so the pace can't be measured.
analysis.breakdownSub: the breakdown of what we detected
analysis.faceSecs: of the seconds with a face detected

autosave: Your brand settings save on their own for your next clips.
unsaved: You have unsaved changes on this clip.

errors.session: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.no_credits: You don't have enough tokens for this. Top up or upgrade your plan.
errors.rate_limited: You reached a limit of your plan. Try again later.
errors.too_large: This is over your plan's maximum size.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find this clip. It may have been deleted.
errors.bad_request: This clip changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.generic: Clips didn't answer this time. Try again in a moment.
